items.title: Cisco CEO on trusting Nvidia chips after Jensen Huang's exit: 'Absolutely'
items.summary: Cisco (CSCO) CEO Chuck Robbins sits down with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to outline his thoughts on what Nvidia's (NVDA) business and the broader tech landscape might look like without Jensen Huang at the helm.

items.title: 3 signs the AI trade is back
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor and Host of Sozzi Unleashed, Brian Sozzi shares three signs that the AI trade may be regaining momentum after a turbulent week. Earnings from Cisco (CSCO), Cerebras (CBRS), and CoreWeave (CRWV) are offering investors renewed optimism and signs of life in a beaten-down AI sector.

items.title: Three positive signs for the AI trade, America's inflation problem, and Huang's Nvidia departure
items.summary:
Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi talks about the week to remember in the investing world, including Nvidia's (NVDA) Jensen Huang's departure, America's stubborn inflation problem, and positive signs that the AI trade is back. 

Sozzi is joined by former Medtronic (MDT) CEO Bill George, who grades the Nvidia board's makeup, its handling of Jensen Huang's departure, and its succession plan.

items.title: 3 signs AI stocks may be a great trade again
items.summary: The AI trade may be back.

items.title: Stock Market Today: Indexes Trim Losses, Manage To Score Weekly Gains Despite Strong Volatility
items.summary: The Dow Jones index fell Friday despite cooler-than-expected inflation data. AI giant Nvidia continued to fall.

items.title: Earnings week scorecard: beats rewarded selectively as AI-infrastructure names pull back
items.summary: Investing.com -- Beats were widespread this week, but the market rewarded only some of them. Cisco and Applied Materials both beat and both sold off. CoreWeave, Rocket Lab and Constellation Energy were rewarded. The week reads as a test of "beat versus priced-in" for the AI-infrastructure trade.

items.title: Cisco earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- Cisco Systems Inc (CSCO) beat on every headline number in FQ1 FY2027 (reported Nov 12, 2026) and still fell. The stock is $95.35, down 6.53% (as of Nov 13, 2:51 PM EST), roughly where it traded before the print and 17% lower over a month.
